item.title: Malaysia records headline inflation of 1.4 percent, core 2 percent in 2025
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia’s headline inflation and core inflation for 2025 will average 1.4 percent and 2 percent respectively, compared to 1.8 percent in 2024, according to Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM). BNM Governor Datuk Seri Abdul Rasheed Ghaffour said in the fourth quarter of 2025, headline inflation remained stable at 1.3 percent (third quarter of 2025: 1.3 percent), while core inflation increased to 2.3 percent (third quarter of 2025: 2.0 percent).
